fact: At ID Day on 18-20 September 2024 in Banfora, ONI ran a special operation to issue national identity cards (CNIB) including to internally displaced persons, with a mechanism for them to identify themselves and have the CNIB reissued.
title: Burkina Faso : un dispositif d'identification mis en place pour les PDI à l'occasion de la Journée internationale de l'identité
